cleavage agent: The flow through was reduced, alkylated and digested with trypsin.
enrichment method: Pierce Top 12 Abundant Protein Depletion Spin Columns
samples were depleted for the most abundant proteins by Pierce Top 12 Abundant Protein Depletion Spin Columns
fractionation method: pooled TMT labeled samples were then separated via basic pH RPLC fractionation into final 24 concatenated fractions.
instrument: analysis in technical duplicates on a QExactive Plus mass spectrometer
labeling: Tryptic peptides (10 μg) were labeled with TMT-6plex reagents (Thermo).
